thread.title: Apple's Warning: Here's What The Bulls Are Saying - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: SA Editors
title: Apple's Warning: Here's What The Bulls Are Saying - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple's surprise revenue warning brings Q1 guidance down to $84 billion, from a mid-point of $91 billion previously. Nearing the close, shares of AAPL are trading 9% lower at $143.60.
-We invite investors who remain BULLISH on Apple to post a comment summarizing their reactions, outlook, and trading strategies.
-If you remain Bullish, what developments/scenario would ultimately cause you to lose confidence?
We invite readers/contributors who are Bullish Apple to post a single comment to this article (please keep it professional and informative).
For users wishing to gauge the Bearish sentiments, please see the article " Apple's Warning: Here's What The Bears Are Saying. "
